summary: Advances the dword pointer at a1 by 8 bytes and returns the 64-bit value that was stored just before the advance.

operations.description: Increment the pointer value stored at a1 by 8 (two dwords).
Dereference the location eight bytes before the new pointer value and return it as a 64-bit value.

unresolved: Whether the 64-bit read is a double, an integer pair, or raw data is not determined by this function alone.
The prelabel structural-twin note (FloatClamp, 004646c0) is DERIVED and not independently confirmed for this address.
